LedgerAccount.title: LedgerAccount
LedgerAccount.description: An apartment function or festival ledger account (e.g., Kali Pujo 2026 or archived Kali Pujo 2025).

name.description: Display name of the function account (1 to 100 chars).

year.description: Calendar year of the function (2000 to 2100).

defaultContribution.description: Standard per-resident contribution amount in INR.

targetBudget.description: Planned total budget for the function in INR.

archived.description: Whether this function account is a historical reference archive.

createdAt.description: Creation server timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last modification server timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

LedgerCategory.title: LedgerCategory
LedgerCategory.description: Income or expense category for organizing apartment function transactions (e.g., Dhak, Thakur, Thakurmasai).

type.description: Whether this category tracks expenses or income.

budgetLimit.description: Optional planned spend cap in INR (0 when unset).

colorHex.description: Hex color token for category badge.

iconKey.description: Identifier for the Material icon representing this category.

createdAt.description: Creation server timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last modification server timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

LedgerEntry.title: LedgerEntry
LedgerEntry.description: A single income or expense transaction in an apartment function account.

accountId.description: Document ID of the parent LedgerAccount under /users/{userId}/accounts/{accountId}.

amount.description: Positive transaction amount in INR (1 to 100000000).

categoryId.description: Document ID of the associated LedgerCategory.

categoryName.description: Denormalized category name for fast report rendering.

notes.description: Description or item details for the ledger entry.

partyName.description: Contributor resident name or expense payee name (empty string if none).

paymentMode.description: How the expense or contribution was settled.

dateStr.description: Formatted date string in dd/MM/yyyy format.

dateEpochMillis.description: Transaction date epoch timestamp in milliseconds for chronological sorting.

createdAt.description: Creation server timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last modification server timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/accounts/{accountId}.description: Function ledger accounts owned by the authenticated apartment account manager.

/users/{userId}/categories/{categoryId}.description: Income and expense categories configured by the user.

/users/{userId}/entries/{entryId}.description: Individual income and expense ledger entries scoped to the user and a LedgerAccount.
